summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a Form 6-K containing its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings news release; the filing reports quarterly results including net revenue of $67.6 million, a 17% YoY increase in international medical cannabis net revenue, and cash of $149.1 million. The only transactional item mentioned is a prior divestiture of Bevo Agtech completed in February 2026, now classified as a discontinued operation; no new special-situation event is being announced. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
